title: Console UI: Standup button + drawer in CurrentStatusPanel
description:
## Goal

Add Standup entry point to the Now panel (CurrentStatusPanel): a button that opens a drawer for on-demand standup output.

## UX

- Button lives in CurrentStatusPanel chrome (Now panel), not under Reports nav.
- Drawer overlays or slides from the panel; user remains in Now context.
- Profile picker: meeting-script vs director-brief.
- Shows loading state while POST /api/standup runs.
- Renders standup sections on success; surfaces API fail-closed errors clearly.
- Flat design per apps/console/AGENTS.md (no gradients, drop-shadows, or container borders).

## Implementation notes

- Call POST /api/standup (kbs-4656c7).
- Behavior locked by Gherkin kbs-44e3e1.

## Depends on

- kbs-4656c7 (API) and kbs-44e3e1 (spec) should land before or in parallel with UI; spec is authoritative.
